contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. PRIMARY VERIFICATION OF CLAUSE 1 (the identification of the group). SRC-0001 (Payne, arXiv:2605.20453v1, retrieved live) states verbatim that 'the subspace W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) is the image of H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) under restriction to the open subspace parameterizing smooth curves. It carries a pure Hodge structure of weight k' — this is Deligne (Hodge II) lowest-weight theory and confirms the finding's opening equation exactly. SRC-0002 (CLP, arXiv:2307.08830v3, retrieved live) supplies the same content in right-exact form, H^{k-2}(bd~M_{g,n}) -> H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) -> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) -> 0, i.e. THM-0003. Arithmetic checks for (6,6): d=3*6-3+6=21; ordinary degree 2d-16=26 with weight 26, so weight=degree and the piece is pure and lowest in its degree; Chow codimension 26/2=13; Poincare duality on the smooth proper stack gives 2*21-26=16, so H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6}) is dual to the CONJ-0001 group H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6}) up to Q(-21). All agree with the TASK target block. VERIFICATION OF CLAUSE 2 (no supplied identification; assuming one is not independent). (i) The relevant implication runs one way only: SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 — the paper's own 'key new technical statement' — is 'if X is smooth and has the CKgP, then W_k H^k(X) is algebraic', and algebraic generation of a pure weight-2p piece forces Tate type ⊕Q(-p). So an identification of W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) with a complex generated by algebraic cotangent/gluing classes would immediately discharge the (6,6) case. An input that yields the conclusion in one step is not an independent input, which is precisely the finding's point. (ii) That input is unavailable at (6,6): THM-0005's CKgP marking bound for g=6 is n<=c(6)=5 < 6 (SRC-0002 Thm 1.10 independently confirms the analogous genus-7 bound, 'For n<=3, the moduli space M_{7,n} has the CKgP and R*(M_{7,n})=A*(M_{7,n})'). (iii) Tautological generation of H^{2p}(Mbar_{g,n}) for ALL (g,n) is known per SRC-0001 only for p<=2, and for p=3 only when g not in {7,8,9}; codimension p=13 is far outside every published range. (iv) Decisively, SRC-0001 records that non-tautological classes occur in even degree and that 'all known examples occur in codimension 11 and higher' — codimension 13 lies inside the regime where decorated-strata generation is known to fail in general, so it cannot be assumed for free at (6,6). (v) Current state of the art confirms the finding rather than refuting it: Bergstrom-Wennink (arXiv:2603.26962v1, 27 Mar 2026), the closest published attempt to run exactly this program, computes weight-graded pieces of H^*(M_{g,n}) from Deligne's weight spectral sequence only under the explicit ASSUMPTIONS that Pixton's relations are complete and that 'the E_1-page consists only of tautological cohomology', verified case-by-case and not proved; and its range 2g+n<=12 excludes (6,6) (2*6+6=18). SCOPE SHARPENINGS (mild, non-defeating, recorded for the record). (a) 'Circular' is best read as 'requires an input at least as strong as the conclusion': algebraic/tautological generation implies Tate type but is strictly stronger (a non-tautological ALGEBRAIC class is still Tate), so the defect is petitio principii in the practical sense unless the attempt's only warrant for the generation claim is the target itself. (b) One inclusion is genuinely available and should not be denied by future reviewers: the codimension-13 tautological/strata classes do push into W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) and their span is Tate; what no supplied argument provides is SURJECTIVITY onto the pure piece. (c) The closing clause is correctly framed as a statement about the supplied argument — it does not, and must not be read to, provide positive evidence that a non-Tate weight-26 summand exists. MERGE ANALYSIS — do not merge. Against FND-0031 (corroborated, group 'pure-corner-depth-one-only'): that finding blocks the Deligne weight SS / Getzler-Kapranov complex at the m=0 corner on the ground that its E_1 terms are cohomology of boundary strata and the m=0 term is the still-unknown compactified group, i.e. unknown-input circularity. FND-0048 blocks a different object — the ALGEBRAIC decorated strata complex, all of whose terms are Tate by construction — on the ground of an unproven generation hypothesis. Different mechanism, different attempt (ATT-0020/REV-0025 vs ATT-0014/REV-0021), and the two are complementary rather than redundant. Against FND-0032: its own adjudication (FAUD-0008) explicitly carved out the decorated case, 'the obstruction is to the undecorated top-weight regime; decorated/lower-weight graph-complex methods are outside this finding and not ruled out here'; FND-0048 fills exactly that flagged gap. Against FND-0033 (semisimplicity/extensions) and FND-0034 (nonseparating divisor Mbar_{5,8}): unrelated content. Against retired FND-0021/FND-0028: those were retired for misdescribing CKgP as a property of the compactification, contradicting THM-0005's open-M_{g,n} scope; FND-0048 makes no such claim and is the correct-scope statement of the residual gap, so it is not a revival of a retired item. Merge target: none. LIMITATIONS DECLARED. (1) ATT-0020 and REV-0025 are absent from this read-only workspace, so the audit verifies the mathematical content and the packet-level absence of any such identification in C66-001-v4; it does not re-audit ATT-0020's section-level provenance, which is not required for the mathematical promotion. (2) Independent extraction of SRC-0002 Table 1 was unreliable (one retrieval reported g=6 bound n<=3, a follow-up reported no Table 1 in the introduction); this is non-load-bearing because n=6 exceeds the bound under either the packet value c(6)=5 or the lower reading, so the compatibility argument with THM-0005 holds regardless. The packet value c(6)=5 is retained. (3) No SHA-256 digests are recorded: this workspace exposes no shell or hashing tool, so content_sha256 is set to null rather than fabricated; URLs, arXiv ids/versions and retrieval date are accurate. (4) Grok 4.5 helper workers were deliberately NOT dispatched: TASK.json sets excluded_engines=['grok'] and the finding's originating reviewer_engines=['grok'], so any grok assistance would void independence. CONCLUSION: promote FND-0048 from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent live verification of the lowest-weight identification (SRC-0001), the CKgP-to-algebraicity implication and boundary sequence (SRC-0002), the codimension-11-and-higher non-tautological regime (SRC-0001), and the assumption-laden, out-of-range state of the art for decorated weight-spectral-sequence computations (arXiv:2603.26962v1).
